description_en: This API is used to obtain the downlink experience quality metrics of a user in a single communication session.
description_zh: 本接口用于获取单次通信中用户的下行体验质量指标
kebab_example: aliyun rtc describe-qoe-metric-data --app-id testappid --channel-id testid --created-ts 1614936817 --user-id testuserid --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeQoeMetricData

parameters.help_en: Channel Creation Time. Supports querying data from the last 30 days. Represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 创建频道时间，支持查询最近30天的数据。使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒
parameters.name: created_ts

parameters.help_en:
Channel release time, represented as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. An empty parameter indicates retrieving data up to the current time.  
If the provided channel release time exceeds the actual release time, data from the Creation Time to the actual release time will be returned
parameters.help_zh:
频道释放时间，使用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒。参数为空表示获取当前时间。
如果传入的频道释放时间超过真实的释放时间，将返回从创建时间开始到真实释放时间之间的数据
parameters.name: destroyed_ts
